Feasibility-only Kotlin port; not integrated into Android product.

SwiftMmcq.kt translates the selected ColorThiefSwift MMCQ implementation:
  repository https://github.com/yamoridon/ColorThiefSwift
  commit ac04a95acca965f8030a01293c31621b2a812c39
  source ColorThiefSwift/Classes/MMCQ.swift
  Copyright (c) 2019 Kazuki Ohara <kazuki.ohara@gmail.com>
  MIT License: accompanying LICENSE contains the full upstream notice.
  Upstream thanks Lokesh Dhakar and Sven Woltmann.

The separate premultiplied RGBA adapter and merged, population-sorted reducer
follow this workspace's macos/PaletteExtraction.swift. The port removes native
platform-color and nearest-color APIs and fixes the quantizer inputs to the
production contract (quality1, ignoreWhite=false, maxColors5). Histograms,
median cuts, counts, averages and queue ordering follow the pinned Swift core.
The unified cross-language diff and source map document changes; preserving
algorithm semantics is demonstrated for the attached fixtures, not every image.

Other downloaded Java/RN/old-Android files are evidence, not port inputs.
Their file headers declare Creative Commons Attribution 2.5, as recorded in
the source manifest and reports. This notice does not relicense those files
or give a legal opinion about upstream provenance.
